summary: Master ethics and integrity leadership through ISO 37301, ISO 37002, and practical reporting workflows. Build controls, dashboards, and action plans.
lede: Integrity-focused leadership practice helps governance, HR, compliance, audit and line-management professionals make conduct decisions consistently. They can assess ethical culture, apply structured decision models, document conflicts of interest, and design whistleblowing triage, escalation and conduct-risk reporting workflows, producing practical controls and dashboards that support accountability across teams.
audienceIntro: This ethics and integrity leadership training is designed for professionals who already work close to governance, conduct, or employee accountability and need a more structured way to lead integrity decisions.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, access to spreadsheet software, and examples of your organisation's code of conduct, escalation process, or speak-up policy if available. Familiarity with basic governance terminology, policy implementation, or case handling will help you move faster through the exercises.
